Are you interested in being part of a high visibility, strategic team that delivers solutions at the intersection of data center infrastructure, energy and water?

description:
Pacifico Energy is a global energy infrastructure firm supporting complex, large load projects from development through to operations. The company serves as a trusted partner across engineering, financing, construction, and optimization, delivering tailored power solutions for large energy users, including data centers. With a proven international track record and over 15 years as a large\-scale developer, Pacifico brings speed and knowledgeable oversight to projects from start to finish.

The company's Chief Investment Officer brings deep data center capital markets, M\&A, and investor\-relationship leadership; this role complements that strength by bringing the hands\-on power and energy expertise needed to finance Pacifico's private grid generation assets across both the debt and equity sides of the capital stack.

  

Reporting to the Chief Investment Officer, the Senior Manager/Director of Structured Finance and Investments is her primary execution resource on power\-specific financing — structuring and closing the debt and equity for Pacifico's gas\-fired AI developments, renewable, and storage projects, and translating development, procurement, and construction milestones into bankable financing structures. It bridges the CIO's strategic capital markets leadership and the technical, domain\-specific demands of the company's power portfolio with real hands\-on execution experience. This role is onsite in our Dallas office. The level of this position will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical expertise, and track record executing power and energy project financings.

title: ESS SKOn Chief Architect
description:
Chief Architect \- Energy Storage Software \& Controls

  

**Position Summary**



SKOn is seeking a Chief Architect to serve as the senior technical leader for its next generation energy storage software, controls, and energy management platform.





Reporting to the Head of EMS Engineering leader responsible for the software and controls organization, the Chief Architect will be the technical counterpart to the business and organizational leader, translating product strategy, customer requirements, and emerging market needs into a scalable technical architecture.





This role will define and govern the architecture spanning Energy Management Systems (EMS), site and plant controls, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), networking, cloud and edge infrastructure, data platforms, cybersecurity, and external system integrations. The Chief Architect will play a central role in building a software and controls center of excellence capable of supporting utility\-scale battery energy storage, grid\-connected applications, and emerging high availability applications such as AI data centers and other mission\-critical loads.





The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong systems thinking and can move comfortably between executive\-level strategy, customer architecture discussions, engineering design reviews, and hands\-on technical problem solving.





**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Architecture \& Technical Strategy**


* Define and govern the end\-to\-end architecture for SK's energy storage software, controls, and EMS platform.
* Establish scalable architectures supporting multiple battery configurations, PCS platforms, grid applications, customer use cases, and deployment models.
* Develop the technical roadmap necessary to evolve from individual project solutions toward repeatable, configurable products and platforms.
* Define system boundaries and interfaces across EMS, plant controls, PCS, BMS, edge computing

We are seeking a Director, Engineering and Interconnection to lead the owner's\-side technical capability supporting Talen Energy's power generation, battery storage, and digital infrastructure development portfolio. The role is accountable for development\-stage project engineering, technology and configuration decisions, technical diligence, and grid and transmission interconnection strategy. **Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operations is responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:


* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start\-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment

* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design \& Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move\-ins and turn\-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.

You will work with the Global Capacity Delivery Program Lead and the broader Data Center Operations organization, to extend its coverage across more sites and platforms as the fleet grows.
